thread:
rachel: FYI Lighthouse Systems says their reseller invoice shows a $14,350 pass-through overage they didn't incur. They claim our partner meter double-counted forwarded requests. Can billing ops audit?

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice RSL-4227 (2026-09-02) attached. Total due: $46,200. Line item: Partner pass-through overage: $14,350.

tom: I pulled partner logs. There's an identifier mismatch causing duplicated event ingestion between 2026-08-25 03:00 and 2026-08-25 07:00 UTC. Partner forwarded same batch twice.

rachel: Do we have a customer-visible impact log? Lighthouse says they only saw normal traffic.

tom: Their telemetry shows single hits. Our partner's forwarding service retried on a 502 and sent the batch again. Partner logs: forward-id ff-77aa twice. Evidence attached to ticket #67211.

kevin: Quick refund calc: overage billed $14,350. Usage attributable to duplicate window = 92% of that (some tokens were legitimately theirs). Proposed credit = $13,200. Recommend also a $400 goodwill credit for their ops time. Net credit = $13,600.

rachel: Are we comfortable absorbing most of it as partner pass-through error? We should also chase partner for restitution.

kevin: We should. For now, issue customer credit and create receivable from partner. GL: AR-Adj (6110), Partner-Recoverable (8202), Promo-7600 for goodwill.

elaine: Since proposed credit > $10k we need CFO approval. Tagging @cfo-bot to route.

cfo-bot: [automated] Approval request created PRQ-8802 for credit $13,600. Requires CFO sign-off.

elaine: CFO approved PRQ-8802 for $13,600 and asked to document "partner-forwarding-duplicate" in the memo. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: [automated] Adjustment ADJ-7220 created. Credits applied: $13,600. Invoice republished: RSL-4227-v2.pdf. Accounting refs: ADJ-7220 / AR-6110 / PART-8202 / PROMO-7600.

rachel: I'll notify Lighthouse with a short note and copy partner ops. Draft: "Hi Lighthouse team  we've investigated and found a partner forwarding duplication that caused the overage. We've applied a $13,600 credit to your account and republished your invoice (RSL-4227-v2). We'll pursue recovery from the partner and follow up with an RCA. Apologies for the inconvenience. - Rachel, Billing Ops"

tom: Also adding internal ticket to partner escalation tracker (PE-304).

rachel: Sent to customer. Lighthouse replied: "Thanks for resolving quickly. Please keep us posted on partner recovery." Closing support ticket #67211.

elaine: Note for ops: flag the partner's forwarding service and restrict large-batch retries until fixed. Tagging eng-partners.

rachel: Closing thread.
